==About==

Crafting {{i|Clover Rolls}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make {{i|Unleavened Clover Roll Dough}} which can then be left to rest inside the Baking Table until it becomes {{i|Leavened Clover Roll Dough}}. Leavened Clover Roll Dough, when baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}}, will produce Clover Rolls. Preparing Foods on a Baking Table removes a small amount of [[Insanity]] and has a chance of giving you an {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}}. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
